newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac to announce Asian move - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac to announce Asian move - paper.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp Ltd will announce a major expansion of its operations in Asia later on Wednesday, The Australian newspaper reported.
"Sources say Westpac has been working on a commercial alliance which will extend the breadth of trade finance and retail services it can offer in the region," the newspaper said.
A spokesman for Westpac told Reuters he could not comment on the report immediately.
Westpac currently does not have a significant Asian presence in its own right.
Westpac's shares closed down three cents at A$7.34 on Tuesday.
